# The protocol-select notification rename is paired across its controller and direct browser tests

This landing replaces the protocol-select notification ID with account-hub-email-protocol-select-additional-info in the controller, Fluent resource and two direct test expectations. The English message ends in a period. The fixed comparison source retains that pairing; the tests assert the localization ID and notification visibility, not translated output or rendered card spacing.

Scope: Account Hub protocol-select notification.
